description: This file implements stack backtrace and crash handling functions using GCC-specific unwind features, including signal handlers, stack trace dumping, and address resolution.

methods.name: backtrace_init
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for crash and stack dump.

methods.name: backtrace
methods.description: Traverses the call stack, invoking a callback for each frame.

methods.name: backtrace_resolve
methods.description: Resolves an address to function and filename strings.
